doc: The sheet fBm (low 2, slope 3) on 64x64: mean 0 and std 1 by construction, so the metrics are shape ones. STATISTICAL: 40 seeds (1000..1039), 5 metrics (names and definitions in params). The port draws its own random numbers, so it cannot reproduce `values`; it computes each metric exactly as defined, for its own seeds, and checks |metric - mean| <= n_sigma * std per metric for one seed (n_sigma * std / sqrt(m) for the mean of m seeds). mean and std (ddof = 1) are what the Python code produces; the recomputation check holds them at 1e-9 (no flipped texel in the nudge experiments).

definitions: Pearson correlation of the field with itself shifted 1 texel along x (circular)
